meta.title: 没有油脂，怎么拉花？
meta.topic: 咖啡 · 拉花 · 油脂

scenes.title_cn: 问题：浓缩没油脂，图案留不住
scenes.title_en: The Problem: No Crema Means No Pattern
scenes.context: 有的豆子或萃取状态下浓缩几乎没油脂，奶泡倒上去图案发白、容易散，拉花怎么都画不漂亮。
sentences: 这杯浓缩几乎没有油脂。
This espresso has almost no crema.
crema（油脂）
奶泡倒上去，图案容易散。
When you pour the milk, the pattern tends to fall apart.
fall apart（散开）
不是手法问题，是载体问题。
It's not your technique — it's the canvas.
canvas（载体）
paraphrase: The drink itself gives the art nothing to stick to.
Fix the base before you re-pour.
scenes.speak: This espresso has almost no crema. When you pour the milk, the pattern tends to fall apart. It's not your technique — it's the canvas.

scenes.title_cn: 对策一：先融合让奶泡托住图案
scenes.title_en: Fix One: Integrate First So the Foam Holds the Art
scenes.context: 油脂不足时，把融合做得更足：让奶泡与咖啡液充分结合，形成一个均匀的『底色』，图案才能有落脚点。融合的深度和转杯的幅度都要加大。
sentences: 先做足融合，让奶泡托住图案。
Integrate fully first, so the foam holds the pattern.
hold the pattern（托住图案）
融合的深度和转杯幅度都要加大。
Go deeper with the pour and widen the swirl of the cup.
swirl（旋转/转杯）
底色均匀了，图案才有落脚点。
Once the base is even, the art has somewhere to land.
somewhere to land（落脚点）
paraphrase: Build a smooth base before you draw on top.
A weak integration leaves the foam with nothing to grab.
scenes.speak: Integrate fully first, so the foam holds the pattern. Go deeper with the pour and widen the swirl of the cup. Once the base is even, the art has somewhere to land.

scenes.title_cn: 对策二：减奶泡厚度，加高度拉花
scenes.title_en: Fix Two: Thin the Foam, Pour from Higher Up
scenes.context: 油脂越少，奶泡要打得越薄，否则图案浮不住；注入时从更高处落下，让奶泡沉入液体而不是浮在表面。这两个调整能显著提升无油脂拉花的成功率。
sentences: 油脂少，奶泡就要打得更薄。
With less crema, steam the milk thinner.
steam thinner（打得更薄）
从更高处落杯，让奶泡沉进去。
Pour from higher up so the foam sinks into the drink.
sink into（沉入）
两个调整，成功率立刻不一样。
These two tweaks change your success rate right away.
success rate（成功率）
paraphrase: 「奶泡厚薄与油脂匹配」换种说法
Match foam thickness to how much crema you have.
Higher pouring buries the foam instead of floating it.
scenes.speak: With less crema, steam the milk thinner. Pour from higher up so the foam sinks into the drink. These two tweaks change your success rate right away.

practice: 「奶泡打得更薄」用英文怎么说？
「从高处落杯让奶泡沉入」怎么讲？
Pour from higher up so the foam sinks in.
pitfalls: Blame your pour when the pattern scatters.
Weak crema is a canvas problem, not a hand problem.
Keep the foam thick and hope for the best.
Steam thinner when crema is low.
Thick foam floats apart on a crema-less surface.
Pour close to the surface every time.
Pour higher so the foam sinks into the drink.
Low pouring keeps the foam floating and the pattern messy.
Skip integration to rush the art.
Integrate fully to give the art a landing surface.
shifts: 根据油脂多少调节厚度
根据油脂情况调整注入高度
